text:
maria: Heads-up — running a quant bakeoff (AWQ / GPTQ / INT8) across T4 vs A100 clusters and hitting driver / Triton / vLLM / TensorRT-LLM compatibility issues. Dumping notes here for triage.

sam: What errors / symptoms are you seeing?

maria: On A100 job got: ```RuntimeError: cuLaunchKernel failed: invalid device function
  at aten::cuda::...
Stack trace truncated.```
This was on CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 8.9, Triton 23.10, vLLM 0.7.2.

jake: Invalid device function usually points to kernel compiled for a different sm or CUDA ABI mismatch. Which trt-llm / triton builds?

maria: Triton 24.09 on the T4 nodes, 23.10 on A100 nodes. trt-llm on A100 is 0.6.0, on T4 we run triton-backed plugin 0.5.x.

olivia: FYI we observed +5% perplexity and notable token-level hallucinations when using AWQ int8 on T4 + Triton 24.09 — looks like fallback to a slower or lower-precision kernel.

chen: Can you paste the exact docker/cmd you ran (so we can repro)?

maria: Sure: ```bash
docker run --gpus all -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \
  -e TRITON_VERSION=24.09 -e VLLM_VERSION=0.7.2 \
  -v /models:/models redwood/quant-bake:latest \
  python run_eval.py --model /models/7b-awq --quant awq --backend triton --batch 4
```

devops-bot: autoscaler: scheduled rolling restart in dev-gpu-pool at 2025-11-03T12:30:00Z (for kernel upgrades) :wrench:

sam: Try disabling Triton's cublasLt fused kernels or set TRT_DISABLE_ENGINE_CACHE=1 — previously helped with silent fallbacks. Also confirm cublasLt version.

maria: Disabled cublasLt but then saw: "No compatible kernel for quantized matmul" and vLLM fell back to CPU for KV cache (massive perf hit). Logs show many 'fallback_to_host' messages.

jake: On A100 we solved similar by rebuilding AWQ kernels with -DUSE_TENSOR_CORE and matching sm arch flags. Could be driver ABI mismatch between CUDA 12.1 and the trt-llm binary (needs CUDA 11.x compat).

olivia: Note: some TRT-LLM 22.x builds expect CUDA 11.8 and silently degrade on newer drivers — you get correctness/perf regressions rather than hard failures.

maria: Quick metrics so far: GPTQ 4-bit on A100 + TensorRT-LLM: median latency ~120ms, p95 ~240ms, accuracy delta vs FP16: -0.6% MRR. On T4 + Triton: median ~210ms, p95 ~430ms, accuracy delta -2.3% MRR (and token hallucination spikes).

chen: Which eval suite / dataset? Push artifacts so we can compare numbers.

maria: Pushed run artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/quant-bakeoffs/1752054321 — includes eval.jsonl, logs/, config.yaml. Look at token-level diffs in eval.jsonl (column 'token_error_spike').

sam: Possible root cause: quant kernel uses different rounding/accumulation ordering so small distribution shifts accumulate on long contexts; also KV cache handling in vLLM with 'use_graphs' sometimes breaks with custom kernels. Try toggling vLLM config 'use_graphs=false' and 'pad_to_eight=false' as a quick test.

olivia: :eyes: I'll start a compatibility matrix doc (CUDA / cuDNN / Triton / vLLM / trt-llm / driver) and share. We need a canonical supported stack for each quant path.

jake: Short-term workaround: pin Triton to 23.10 + driver 525.* on T4 nodes, or use the A100 nodes with rebuilt trt-llm plugin. Longer term: rebuild trt-llm for CUDA12 or migrate to a wheel that supports newer CUDA.

maria: Working with infra to repro on a clean node. If anyone has quick patches to vLLM (KV cache handling) or trt-llm to test, ping me in DM and I'll run them. Thanks everyone.
